derivation: the main flow works. 2 things in the build do not match what you asked for — the missing mix-ratio status line and batches do not survive a restart (t-3-ac1, t-4-ac1) — and none of them is from the PRD itself: worth reading before you merge.

criteria.text: The board shows every recorded grout batch in one list on the page.
criteria.note: The list sits right under the header and shows three batches, one line each — B-1041, B-1042 and B-1043 with their type and colour.

criteria.text: A new batch can be added from the board itself, without leaving the page.
criteria.note: The add row is right there on the board: a 'new batch code' input across the width with an ADD BATCH button beside it, so you add without leaving the page.

criteria.text: The board names itself in a header so the tiler knows what he is looking at.
criteria.note: An orange band across the top names it GROUT TRACKER (background rgb(224,138,60)), exactly as the drawing asks.

criteria.text: The batch list is the first thing under the header.
criteria.note: The list opens at y=71, immediately below the header which ends at y=51 — nothing sits between them.

criteria.text: An ADD BATCH button sits to the right of the input.
criteria.note: ADD BATCH is at the far right (x=1293) with the input filling the space to its left (x=20, w=1263) — button right of the input as drawn.

criteria.text: A status line beneath the add row shows the current mix ratio.
criteria.note: Your drawing has an orange mix-ratio line under the add row; it isn't there at all — below the add row the page drops straight to the footer.
Your own test for this ran and went red — it found the batch list empty after a restart (expected B-1041, got nothing).

criteria.text: The export writes valid CSV with a header row.
criteria.note: I could not check this. Nothing on screen shows an export, and your suite runs only two tests — the header and the restart — so it says nothing about CSV export.

gaps.title: the missing mix-ratio status line
gaps.expected: an orange status line beneath the add row with the mix ratio and how many batches are open
gaps.saw: nothing there — below the add row the page goes straight to the footer

gaps.title: batches do not survive a restart
gaps.expected: the batches you added still there after a restart
gaps.saw: an empty list — the test found nothing where B-1041 should have been

alsoChecked: The ADD button is teal (background rgb(90,166,184)); your drawing doesn't say what colour it should be, so I'm treating that as the builder's call.
There's a footer reading 'grout tracker · sandbox build' at the bottom; the drawing is silent on a footer, so that's the builder's call too and no fault.
summary: The board itself is right: the orange GROUT TRACKER header, the batch list of three sitting directly beneath it, and an add row with the ADD BATCH button to the right of the input — all three of your PRD goals are on screen. Two of the plan's pieces fall short: the mix-ratio status line the drawing puts under the add row isn't there at all, and your own persistence test ran and failed, finding the list empty after a restart. Export I could not check — nothing on screen and no test covers it.
